verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const read=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const walk=(d)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return[];return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((x)=>{const p=path.join(d,x.name);return x.isDirectory()?(x.name==="node_modules"?[]:walk(p)):[p]})};const v1=()=>walk("app/api/v1").filter((f)=>/route\.ts$/.test(f));const v1src=()=>v1().map(read).join("\n");const P=read("proxy.ts");const m=P.match(/matcher:\s*\[([\s\S]*?)\]\s*,?\s*\}/);if(!m)process.exit(79);if(!/well-known/.test(m[1]))fail("proxy.ts runs on /.well-known/*, so the association files get a session refresh and a first-touch cookie");const c=walk("app").filter((f)=>/[\\/]\.well-known[\\/]/.test(f)).concat(walk("public/.well-known"));const a=c.filter((f)=>/apple-app-site-association/.test(f));if(!a.length)fail("no apple-app-site-association is served");const src=a.map(read).join("\n");if(/TEAM_ID\./.test(src))fail("the association file hardcodes the TEAM_ID placeholder instead of reading the team id from the environment");if(!/APPLE_TEAM_ID/.test(src))fail("the association file does not read APPLE_TEAM_ID");if(/\/broadcast/.test(src))fail("the association file still claims /broadcast/*, a route that does not exist");for(const p of ["/n/","/q/","/spaces/","/practices/"])if(!src.includes(p))fail("the association file does not claim "+p+"*");if(!/application\/json/.test(src))fail("the association file is not served as application/json");if(!c.some((f)=>/assetlinks/.test(f)))fail("no assetlinks.json for the later Android app");console.log("ok")'
